The 3-line WhatsApp message Dubai property owners actually reply to 📲

"Hi [name], I'm a broker working in [community]. A 2-bed in your building just sold for AED [X], and I have a buyer looking for the same layout. Would you consider an offer?"

Short. Specific. About their building, not about you. Save this for your next owner outreach, and always message 9am–6pm and respect opt-outs.

Handover season = listing season 🔑

Owners who bought off-plan must decide: move in, let or sell, and most have never done it in Dubai before.

Track handover dates by tower (Creek Harbour, MBR City, JVC…), message owners before keys are released and show let vs. sell side by side. The first credible broker usually wins the mandate.

Listings are won on the follow-up, not the first message. 🔁

Day 1: a short WhatsApp intro about their building
Day 3: a call. Ask one question, then listen
Day 10: a useful number, like a recent sale or rent nearby
Every month: stay in touch until they're ready

Message 9am–6pm and stop when asked. Save this for your team.
